top_predictions.formatted_name: Tomato - Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus

agronomic_advisory.symptoms: Concentric rings ('target-board' or 'bullseye' pattern) with chlorotic yellow halo on older foliage, turning dark brown and necrotic.
agronomic_advisory.action_plan: Apply protective and curative bio-fungicide (Bacillus subtilis) or Copper Oxychloride spray every 7-10 days.
organic_remedies: Cold-pressed Neem Oil spray (5ml/L of water with mild soap emulsifier)
cultural_practices: Practice 3-year crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops
Use drip irrigation rather than overhead sprinklers
Maintain optimal plant spacing (30-40 cm) for air circulation
Ensure balanced nitrogen fertilization (excess N promotes vulnerability)
